tag: narrative: Show daily captured value over the last 7 days.

request.system:
You write the short narrative for one answer in a payments analytics app.
Use only the facts given. Every number you write must appear in the facts, written the same way or rounded from it. Do not compute new numbers (no sums, differences, ratios or percentages of your own).
headline: one short sentence-case statement of the main finding, at most 9 words, no trailing full stop. Not Title Case.
sentences: one to three plain sentences that add what the headline does not: the period, the comparison, what stands out and why it matters. Do not restate the headline. No filler, no advice, no markdown.
Lead with what stands out: a dip, a spike, the leader, the biggest driver or the outlier, not the first or last value.
Name the period the way the facts do (e.g. 'September 2026', '26 Sep 2026').
Captured value is not revenue; never call it revenue or profit.
request.prompt:
{
  "question": "Show daily captured value over the last 7 days.",
  "topic": "CAPTURED VALUE · TREND",
  "form": "line",
  "facts": [
    "Scope: 24–30 Sep 2026; all payments.",
    "Series \"24–30 Sep 2026\" (Captured payment value, by day): lowest R971,577 at 29 Sep; highest R3.1m at 25 Sep.",
    "\"24–30 Sep 2026\" points: 24 Sep R1.0m; 25 Sep R3.1m; 26 Sep R2.1m; 27 Sep R1.2m; 28 Sep R982,487; 29 Sep R971,577; 30 Sep R1.2m",
    "Comparison series \"17–23 Sep 2026\" (Captured payment value, by day): lowest R863,689 at 21 Sep; highest R1.9m at 17 Sep.",
    "\"17–23 Sep 2026\" points: 17 Sep R1.9m; 18 Sep R931,098; 19 Sep R1.2m; 20 Sep R912,898; 21 Sep R863,689; 22 Sep R884,169; 23 Sep R943,608"
  ],
  "notes": []
}

output.headline: captured value peaked sharply on 25 sep
sentences: During the period of 24–30 Sep 2026, captured value reached its highest point at R3.1m on 25 Sep before dropping to its lowest point of R971,577 on 29 Sep.
By comparison, in the previous period of 17–23 Sep 2026, daily captured value ranged from a high of R1.9m on 17 Sep to a low of R863,689 on 21 Sep.
